title: Choose the coaching page’s visual world
question: Each direction starts from scratch, preserves the real coaching offer and proof, and uses fluid responsive proportions rather than fixed-pixel composition.

options.label: Jeepney Route Workshop
options.lineage: hand-painted Philippine jeepney destination boards and route tickets
options.thesis: A personal route to fluency, hand-painted around Aljohn’s Filipino identity and the learner’s next real conversation.
options.viewport: Below the shared navbar, a monumental destination board carries FROM THEORY TO REAL-WORLD FLUENCY while a fluid route line moves through input, practice, conversation, and proof; the booking action sits at the route’s departure point.
options.risk: The cultural reference becomes costume if the route does not remain the real information architecture.

raised.raise: The route gains dense discoverable micro-stops and crisp scale changes without borrowing pixel art.
The destination board adopts uncompromising billing hierarchy so the offer reads in seconds.
Progress marks become precise and measurable instead of decorative.
Case-study details reveal through tactile route tickets rather than generic cards.
The seven-month proof is paced honestly as maturation over time.

options.label: Subtitle Cutting Room
options.lineage: documentary subtitle editing suites and film contact sheets
options.thesis: Coaching becomes the edit that turns hours of language input into one clear, speakable story.
options.viewport: A fluid 40/60 split pairs the offer and booking action with L.A.’s real video, dual-language subtitle tracks, and a seven-month edit timeline that makes the proof visible immediately.
options.risk: It is the clearest fit, but also the most familiar to visitors who already associate Aljohn with video.

options.label: Conversation Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: The learner’s noisy input resolves into a stable conversational signal through calibration, practice, and feedback.
options.viewport: A full-width signal display changes from static to a stable speech waveform beside the offer; Aljohn’s portrait, the 500 PHP readout, and the booking control sit in a measured instrument rail.
options.case: It makes transformation exceptionally concrete and interactive, but identifies first with technical instruments rather than language culture.
options.risk: If the language evidence recedes, visitors may mistake the page for a software product.

options.label: Polyglot Pixel City
options.thesis: Every learning habit becomes a discoverable city block.
options.viewport: A zoomable city maps coaching habits and proof into districts.
options.case: The discovery energy is memorable, but the coaching offer and human proof become secondary.
options.kept: Dense discoverable detail and crisp scale changes.
options.risk: The page would read as a game before it reads as coaching.

options.label: Fluency Night Handbill
options.thesis: The coaching offer is billed with the urgency of one unmissable live performance.
options.viewport: A stacked bill leads from the promise to the case study and booking action.
options.case: The conversion hierarchy is strong, but it can misrepresent a bookable service as an event.
options.risk: It can feel theatrical where the offer needs personal trust.

options.label: Fluency Datamatics
options.thesis: Immersion hours and conversation milestones become a black-and-white field of evidence.
options.viewport: Dense progress data surrounds one sharp transformation claim and booking action.
options.case: It communicates intensity, but not the warmth or practical guidance of a real coach.
options.risk: The learner can disappear behind the data aesthetic.

options.label: Language Box Archive
options.thesis: Every coaching milestone opens like a labeled box from a learner’s personal archive.
options.viewport: Stacked session boxes reveal methods, proof, and expectations.
options.case: The reveal states are tactile, but the product’s route and conversation mechanism are unclear.
options.kept: Tactile reveal states instead of generic cards.
options.risk: The archive metaphor over-organizes a service built around people.

options.label: Seven-Month Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Fluency matures through repeated daily conditions rather than one dramatic hack.
options.viewport: Seven dated vessels pace L.A.’s progress beside the booking offer.
options.case: The honest time metaphor is excellent, but the food world has no natural bond with the coaching audience.
options.risk: It would be memorable for the wrong subject.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A direct coaching landing page with a confident hero, testimonial proof, benefits, price, and one repeated booking action.
canonCard.viewport: A clear split hero with Aljohn’s portrait, concise offer, price, and booking action above a video testimonial.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to understand and easy to forget.
